payload.text: `forward_call_strike_slope` returns the sticky (∂σ/∂K-ignoring) strike-derivative of the forward call price as `-Φ(d2)`, where `d2 = d1 - σ√t` from the smile's implied vol at the strike. Since `Φ ∈ [0,1]`, the returned slope lies in `[-1, 0]` — the no-arbitrage bound on a call's monotone-decreasing strike profile. Pure: it reads the smile and scalar inputs and returns an `f64`, mutating nothing.
